en_title: Animated John Wick Prequel Film in the Works Starring Keanu Reeves
cn_title: 基努·里维斯主演的《疾速追杀》动画前传电影正在制作中
opus_summary: 《疾速追杀》动画前传电影正在制作，基努·里维斯将回归饰演约翰·威克。影片讲述他在首部电影之前完成「不可能的任务」的故事，由Shannon Tindle执导。另有《疾速追杀5》及一款系列游戏正在开发。

paragraphs.en: Keanu Reeves is returning as John Wick in an animated film that aims to tell the assassin’s story before the tragic events of the first movie.
paragraphs.cn: 基努·里维斯将在一部动画电影中回归饰演John Wick，这部电影旨在讲述这名杀手在第一部电影的悲剧事件发生之前的故事。

paragraphs.en: The animated flick will be produced by the same team that produced the John Wick movies , comprised of Thunder Road’s Basil Iwanyk and Erica Lee, 87Eleven Entertainment’s Chad Stahelski, and, of course, Keanu Reeves. Point Grey will join the group to produce, as well.
paragraphs.cn: 这部动画电影将由制作《疾速追杀》系列电影的原班团队制作，成员包括Thunder Road的Basil Iwanyk和Erica Lee、87Eleven Entertainment的查德·斯塔赫斯基，以及当然还有基努·里维斯。Point Grey也将加入制作团队。

paragraphs.en: Reeves is also set to reprise his role as the ‘Baba Yaga.’ As told by Lionsgate, this movie will “go back in time to tell the story of John Wick before the first film, as he completes the Impossible Task in order to free himself from his obligation to the High Table and earn the right to be with the love of his life, Helen.” (It’ll be nice to see John Wick being happy, for once.)
paragraphs.cn: 里维斯也将再次饰演「Baba Yaga」。据Lionsgate介绍，这部电影将「回到过去，讲述第一部电影之前John Wick的故事：他为了摆脱对High Table的义务，并赢得与一生挚爱Helen在一起的权利，完成了不可能完成的任务」。（能看到John Wick开心一次会很不错。）

paragraphs.en: Shannon Tindle, an Emmy Award-winning director, writer, and producer known for works like Ultraman: Rising and Kubo and the Two Strings is set to direct. Screenwriting duo Ryan and Kaz Firpo are onboard to write the film; the two are known for Marvel’s Eternals .
paragraphs.cn: 凭借《大怪兽加美拉：重生》和《魔弦传说》等作品为人所知的艾美奖获奖导演、编剧兼制片人Shannon Tindle将执导该片。编剧搭档Ryan Firpo和Kaz Firpo已加盟撰写剧本；两人因漫威的《永恒族》而为人所知。

paragraphs.en: This is the latest news we’ve gotten from this highly-anticipated project after it was first announced last year. Adam Fogelson, motion picture chair at Lionsgate, gave fans a little something to chew on during its announcement, saying, “In both animation and the world of ‘John Wick,’ the possibilities are endless. And there is no ‘John Wick’ story fans are clamoring for more than the ‘Impossible Task.’ Shannon’s take on that story is an incredible one, and we are beyond excited to see what John Wick can do in animation.”
paragraphs.cn: 这是这个备受期待的项目去年首次公布后，我们获得的最新消息。Lionsgate电影部门主席Adam Fogelson在项目公布时给了粉丝一些值得琢磨的信息，他说：「无论是在动画中，还是在《疾速追杀》的世界里，可能性都是无限的。没有哪个《疾速追杀》故事比『不可能完成的任务』更让粉丝迫切想看了。Shannon对这个故事的诠释令人难以置信，我们无比期待看到John Wick在动画中能做到什么。」

paragraphs.en: The specific animation house responsible for bringing John Wick’s action-packed, assassin-filled world to life has not yet been officially announced. For now, it’s anyone’s guess as to what it will eventually look like, but it’s certainly exciting news while we wait for John Wick 5.
paragraphs.cn: 负责将John Wick这个动作场面不断、遍布杀手的世界呈现出来的具体动画制作公司尚未正式公布。目前，谁也猜不准它最终会是什么样子，但在我们等待《疾速追杀5》之际，这无疑是个令人兴奋的消息。

paragraphs.en: Yes, a fifth movie installment is going to happen, despite the fourth movie appearing to end on a perfect note. The film was first revealed in April 2025, with Fogelson most recently saying that director “Chad [Stahelski] and Keanu have an idea that they think can be really exciting.”
paragraphs.cn: 没错，尽管第四部电影似乎以完美的方式收尾，第五部电影仍将拍摄。该片于2025年4月首次公布，Fogelson最近表示，导演「查德［斯塔赫斯基］和基努有了一个他们认为可能非常令人兴奋的想法」。

paragraphs.en: Previously, Stahelski said a script was in active development, though the actual story seemed to be eluding him and fellow writer Mike Finch.
paragraphs.cn: 此前，斯塔赫斯基表示剧本正在积极开发中，不过他和编剧搭档Mike Finch似乎还没想出具体的故事。

paragraphs.en: “I’m not going to lie to you, it’s a bit of a conundrum. Me and Mike Finch — the writer on 4 who’s also writing 5 — we’ve got a pretty good story that I think is cool. Once we have a 50-page book, and if we’re feeling it, we’ll sit with Keanu and shape this thing. Look, everybody seems to want it. It’s a matter of whether we crack it. We’re actively working on it. It’s just … is it going to be satisfying?” he said in an interview with The Hollywood Reporter.
paragraphs.cn: 他在接受好莱坞报道者采访时说：「我不骗你，这有点棘手。我和Mike Finch——第四部的编剧，他也在写第五部——有了一个相当不错的故事，我觉得很酷。等我们有了50页的故事梗概，如果我们觉得对味，就会和基努坐下来，把它塑造出来。你看，大家似乎都想要这部电影。问题在于我们能否把它搞定。我们正在积极推进。只是……它会让人满意吗？」

paragraphs.en: These aren’t the only John Wick projects in the works; Reeves is also portraying the titular character in a video game from Saber Interactive, coming to PlayStation 5, Xbox X|S, and PC at an as-yet unreleased date. An official blurb described what players can expect from the title, saying, “Saber's design will be faithful to the unique style and signature elements of the series, including a distinct gun fu combat system, jaw-dropping camerawork, immersive driving experiences, and a variety of memorable environments, all crafted to make players feel like they are in a John Wick movie, playing the role of John Wick himself."
paragraphs.cn: 这些并不是目前仅有的《疾速追杀》相关项目；里维斯还将在Saber Interactive制作的一款电子游戏中饰演片名主角，该游戏将登陆PS5、XBOX X|S和PC，发售日期尚未公布。一段官方简介描述了玩家可以期待的游戏内容：「Saber的设计将忠实于该系列的独特风格和标志性元素，包括别具一格的枪斗术战斗系统、令人惊叹的镜头运用、沉浸式驾驶体验，以及各种令人难忘的场景，所有这些都旨在让玩家感觉自己身处一部《疾速追杀》电影中，亲自扮演John Wick。」
